name: exostosin glycosyltransferase 2

function.text: EXT2 encodes exostosin-2. Annotated molecular activities include glucuronosyltransferase activity and glycosyltransferase activity. It participates in ossification and glycosaminoglycan biosynthetic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to exostoses, multiple, type 2 (autosomal dominant); seizures-scoliosis-macrocephaly syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Chondrosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
